header: Cold storage requirements and performance considerations
content:
Because cold storage uses Amazon S3, it incurs none of the overhead of hot storage, such as
replicas, Linux reserved space, and OpenSearch Service reserved space. Cold storage doesn't have
speciﬁc instance types because it doesn't have any compute capacity attached to it. You can store
any amount of data in cold storage. Monitor the ColdStorageSpaceUtilization metric in
Amazon CloudWatch to see how much cold storage space you're using.

hierarchy.parent: Cold storage for Amazon OpenSearch Service
